description: Owner only, signed-in session: permanently delete this workspace and everything in it — agents, contacts, calls, recordings, transcripts, lines, API keys and members' access. confirmName must equal the workspace name. Refused while calls are active or a Twilio line exists (delete it first so SAGOT removes what it created in your Twilio account). Cannot be undone; backups expire within about 31 days.

confirmName.description: The workspace's exact current name, to confirm.

name: workspaces_delete
